author: FlufflesSub
body: Only a slight suggestion, you guys encourage a fantastic community, and I think a rather neat idea would be to introduce Lobby challenges, for possible prizes ranging from credits, gadgets and ranks? An example would be 'First to complete parkour.' What are your opinions on this idea, and do you have any other challenge ideas?
